what: ServiceTitan makes software for home and commercial trades: plumbers, electricians, roofers and HVAC contractors use it to schedule jobs, dispatch technicians, quote work, invoice and run marketing.
customers: Residential and commercial trade contractors in North America, on subscriptions plus payment fees.
money: platform access by technician or office seat
payment processing and financing on jobs booked in the platform
moat: A contractor runs the whole business in it: scheduling, pricing, payroll and payments. Leaving means rebuilding how the company operates, not just swapping an app.
risks: A $129M net loss, largely stock compensation after the 2024 listing
7 times sales for a company that is not yet profitable
Trade contractor demand follows home services spending, which follows the housing cycle
opportunities: $137M of free cash flow and $429M of cash against $51M of debt
Revenue grew from $468M to $961M in three years
Analysts see about 26% upside, and payments revenue grows faster than subscriptions at better economics
watch: Net dollar retention and the share of revenue from payments.
